metadata.title: Almgren minimality of products of simplex-skeleton cones
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we prove that for every $m,n\geq 2$, the orthogonal product $S_m\times S_n\subset\R^m\times\R^n$ is an Almgren minimal cone of dimension $m+n-2$, where $S_k\subset\R^k$ is the cone over the $(k-2)$-skeleton of a regular $k$-simplex. Lawlor and Morgan \cite{LM94} proved the minimality of each $S_k$ by paired calibrations, while Guy David \cite{DJT, GD13} later raised the general question whether products of Almgren minimal sets remain minimal. Our theorem gives a affirmative answer to this product question within the entire Lawlor-Morgan regular-simplex family. It extends the isolated example \(\Y\times \Y\), the product of two 1-dimensional $\Y$ sets, proved in 2014 by the second author, simultaneously to all pairwise products \(S_m\times S_n\), and therefore produces a large new family of possible codimension-two singularities for Plateau's problem. The key idea of the proof is to find a new way to combine homology with paired calibrations in higher codimension. Instead of using only the currents associated with the facets, we consider all their nonzero $\FF$ combinations. The resulting complete family has enough algebraic symmetry to control uniformly the overlaps created by noninjective deformations.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 高余维极小锥乘积定理
analysis.workSummary: 证明任意 m,n≥2 时正单纯形骨架锥 S_m×S_n 为维数 m+n−2 的 Almgren 极小锥，将 Y×Y 例子推广到整个 Lawlor–Morgan 族的两两正交积。
analysis.breakthrough: 提供大批余维二 Plateau 奇点候选，并在明确例族内解决极小集乘积保持性。
analysis.limitations: 并未证明任意 Almgren 极小集的乘积都极小；正交积与指定单纯形族不可省。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者将两项关键估计的代数化简明确归于 GPT-6 Astra，借助对称恒等式和算子范数估计替代原有直接计算，并引出高维版本；几何论证由作者完成。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.27845v1 · 第4页 Statement on the use of AI

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者将两项关键估计的代数化简明确归于 GPT-6 Astra，借助对称恒等式和算子范数估计替代原有直接计算，并引出高维版本；几何论证由作者完成。

analysis.priorityReason: 几何测度论中乘积极小性与高余维校准的重要进展。
